source.text: בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְפֶ֖קַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ מָלַ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בֶּן־יוֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] year seventeen year of Pekah son of Remaliah reigned Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah.

en.L: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham, king of Judah, reigned.
en.B: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah.
en.R: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah. It was the seventeenth year that Pekah son of Remaliah had been king of Israel.

es.L: En el año diecisiete de Peka hijo de Remalías, reinó Acaz hijo de Jotam, rey de Judá.
es.B: En el año diecisiete de Peka hijo de Remalías, Acaz hijo de Jotam comenzó a reinar en Judá.
es.R: Acaz hijo de Jotam comenzó a reinar en Judá. Era el año diecisiete del reinado de Peka hijo de Remalías en Israel.

fr.L: En la dix-septième année de Péqah fils de Remalia, Achaz fils de Jotham, roi de Juda, régna.
fr.B: La dix-septième année du règne de Péqah, fils de Remalia, Achaz, fils de Jotham, devint roi de Juda.
fr.R: Achaz fils de Jotham est devenu roi de Juda. C’était la dix-septième année du règne de Péqah fils de Remalia, roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa Peka mwana wa Remalia, Ahazi mwana wa Yothamu, mfalme wa Yuda, alitawala.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa Peka mwana wa Remalia, Ahazi mwana wa Yothamu alianza kutawala Yuda.
sw.R: Ahazi mwana wa Yothamu alianza kutawala Yuda. Ilikuwa katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa utawala wa Peka mwana wa Remalia mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Năm thứ mười bảy đời Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia, A-cha con trai Giô-tham vua Giu-đa trị vì.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười bảy đời Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia, A-cha con trai Giô-tham lên làm vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: A-cha con trai Giô-tham lên làm vua Giu-đa. Lúc ấy là năm thứ mười bảy đời Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 르말랴의 아들 베가의 제십칠년에 유다 왕 요담의 아들 아하스가 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 르말랴의 아들 베가가 다스린 지 십칠 년째 되는 해에 유다 왕 요담의 아들 아하스가 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 요담의 아들 아하스가 유다의 왕이 되었다. 그때는 르말랴의 아들 베가가 이스라엘의 왕이 된 지 십칠 년째 되는 해였다.

decisions.choice: dated by the reign of Pekah, king of Israel
decisions.reason: As throughout Kings, the start of a reign in Judah is dated by the year of the king ruling in Israel (1 Kings 15:1). Pekah had seized the throne of Israel in Samaria (15:25). Ahaz's reign is told in verses 1-20, and again in 2 Chronicles 28.

decisions.choice: Ahaz ... king of Judah: the title belongs to Ahaz
decisions.reason: "King of Judah" describes Ahaz, who now begins to reign, not his father Jotham. The verb "reigned" with a date marks the start of the reign, as in 1 Kings 15:1.

decisions.choice: Ahaz son of Jotham: the king of Isaiah 7
decisions.reason: This is the Ahaz whom the prophet Isaiah met in the crisis of verse 5 (Isaiah 7:1-17), and to whom he gave the sign of Immanuel.

decisions.choice: two sentences, the date second
decisions.reason: Readable splits the formula into two sentences, as these books allow, and says that Pekah was king of Israel.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־עָשָׂ֣ה הַיָּשָׁ֗ר בְּעֵינֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו כְּדָוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of twenty year[s] [was] Ahaz when he became king, and sixteen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and not he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh his God like David his father.

en.L: Ahaz [was] twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not do the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, like David his father.
en.B: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, as his ancestor David had done.
en.R: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. He did not do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God said was right, as his ancestor David had done.

es.L: Acaz [tenía] veinte años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén. Y no hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, como David su padre.
es.B: Acaz tenía veinte años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén. No hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.
es.R: Acaz tenía veinte años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante dieciséis años. No hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios, como lo había hecho su antepasado David.

fr.L: Achaz avait vingt ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Et il ne fit pas ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme David son père.
fr.B: Achaz avait vingt ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Il ne fit pas ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, comme l’avait fait son ancêtre David.
fr.R: Achaz avait vingt ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant seize ans. Il n’a pas fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu déclare bon, comme l’avait fait son ancêtre David.

sw.L: Ahazi [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye alitawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu. Wala hakufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama Daudi baba yake.
sw.B: Ahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu. Hakufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.
sw.R: Ahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na sita. Hakufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake aliyoyaona kuwa mema, kama babu yake Daudi alivyofanya.

vi.L: A-cha [được] hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ông không làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông như Đa-vít tổ phụ ông.
vi.B: A-cha được hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ông không làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông như Đa-vít tổ tiên ông đã làm.
vi.R: A-cha được hai mươi tuổi khi lên làm vua, và ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười sáu năm. Ông không làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông cho là phải, như Đa-vít tổ tiên ông đã làm.

ko.L: 아하스가 왕이 되었을 때 이십 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 십육 년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그는 그의 조상 다윗처럼 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 하지 않았다.
ko.B: 아하스는 이십 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 십육 년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 달리 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 아하스는 스무 살에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 십육 년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 그의 조상 다윗과 달리, 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty years: twenty years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: twenty years old, sixteen years: numbers hard to fit together
alternatives: twenty-five years old (some Greek copies of 2 Chronicles 28:1)
decisions.reason: Ahaz's son Hezekiah was twenty-five when he became king after him (18:2). If Ahaz was twenty at his accession and reigned sixteen years, he would have been about eleven when Hezekiah was born. Reigns that overlapped with a father's, or an error in copying one of the numbers, may explain this. 2 Chronicles 28:1 has the same numbers in Hebrew, but some ancient Greek copies there read twenty-five. Every level keeps the numbers of the Hebrew text; reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: no mother named
decisions.reason: The formula for a king of Judah usually names his mother (15:2, 33). For Ahaz it names none. The text gives no reason.

decisions.choice: he did not do what was right ... like David: the good verdict denied
decisions.reason: The verdict is the one given to the good kings of Judah (1 Kings 15:11), turned into a denial. His father Jotham and the kings before him had received the good verdict (15:3, 34). "David his father" means his ancestor David, the measure for every king of Judah.

decisions.choice: did not do the right in [the] eyes of / did not do what was right in the sight of / did not do what the LORD his God said was right; his ancestor
decisions.reason: The good verdict is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings, here with "not". Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" for "father", as they do wherever David is called the father of a later king.

decisions.choice: "no hizo lo recto a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "no hizo lo que agrada al SEÑOR" (R); "su antepasado David" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The good verdict keeps its fixed wording at each level, here with "no"; Balanced and Readable say "antepasado" where David is called the father of a later king.

source.text: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֤ם אֶת־בְּנוֹ֙ הֶעֱבִ֣יר בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֤ישׁ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he walked in [the] way of [the] kings of Israel, and even his son he made pass in the fire, according to [the] abominations of the nations whom dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and he even made his son pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel. He even made his son pass through the fire, following the detestable practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: He lived the way the kings of Israel had lived. He even burned his own son in the fire as a sacrifice. He copied the disgusting practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out of the land ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y anduvo en el camino de los reyes de Israel, y aun hizo pasar a su hijo por el fuego, conforme a las abominaciones de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Anduvo en el camino de los reyes de Israel. Incluso hizo pasar a su hijo por el fuego, siguiendo las prácticas detestables de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Vivió como habían vivido los reyes de Israel. Hasta quemó a su propio hijo en el fuego como sacrificio. Imitó las prácticas repugnantes de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había echado de la tierra para dar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il marcha dans la voie des rois d’Israël, et même il fit passer son fils par le feu, selon les abominations des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dépossédées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il marcha dans la voie des rois d’Israël. Il alla jusqu’à faire passer son fils par le feu, selon les pratiques abominables des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il a vécu comme les rois d’Israël. Il a même brûlé son propre fils dans le feu, en sacrifice. Il a imité les pratiques dégoûtantes des peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés du pays devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Naye akaenda katika njia ya wafalme wa Israeli, hata mwanawe akampitisha motoni, sawasawa na machukizo ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Aliifuata njia ya wafalme wa Israeli. Hata alimpitisha mwanawe motoni, akifuata desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Aliishi kama wafalme wa Israeli walivyoishi. Hata alimchoma mwanawe mwenyewe motoni kuwa dhabihu. Aliiga desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza kutoka katika nchi mbele ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Ông đi theo đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, và còn cho con trai mình đi qua lửa, theo các điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ông đi theo đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông còn cho con trai mình đi qua lửa, theo những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ông sống theo cách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã sống. Ông còn thiêu chính con trai mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế. Ông bắt chước những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi ra khỏi xứ trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 이스라엘 왕들의 길로 걸었고, 심지어 그의 아들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 했다. 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 가증한 일들을 따른 것이었다.
ko.B: 그는 이스라엘 왕들의 길로 걸었다. 그는 심지어 자기 아들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 역겨운 관습을 따른 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 이스라엘 왕들이 살던 대로 살았다. 그는 심지어 자기 아들을 불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들 앞에서 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 끔찍한 풍습을 그대로 따랐다.

decisions.choice: walked in the way of the kings of Israel: followed the northern kings in their worship
decisions.reason: To walk in someone's way is to live as they did. The kings of Israel worshiped at Jeroboam's shrines and, under Ahab, served Baal. Kings says the same of only two earlier kings of Judah, Jehoram and Ahaziah, who were related to Ahab by marriage (8:18, 27).

decisions.choice: made his son pass through the fire: burned his son as an offering
decisions.reason: The phrase names the rite of offering a child by fire to a god. 2 Chronicles 28:3 says of Ahaz that he "burned his sons in the fire", and Jeremiah 7:31 speaks of burning sons and daughters in the fire. Some have thought the phrase could mean a rite of passing a child through fire to dedicate it without killing it, but these passages point to a burnt sacrifice. Ahaz's grandson Manasseh did the same (21:6), and the northern kingdom too (17:17).

decisions.choice: the abominations of the nations: the practices Deuteronomy forbids
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 18:9-10 warns Israel not to learn "the abominations of those nations" and forbids first of all anyone "who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire" (also Deuteronomy 12:31). Ahaz does what the law named first among those abominations.

decisions.choice: the nations whom Yahweh drove out: the peoples Israel replaced
decisions.reason: Yahweh drove out the peoples of Canaan because of such practices (Deuteronomy 18:12). The king of Judah now takes up the very ways for which those nations lost the land, as was said of Judah under Rehoboam (1 Kings 14:24).

decisions.choice: burned his own son in the fire as a sacrifice
decisions.reason: Readable says what "pass through the fire" meant (m2), as it does at Deuteronomy 18:10. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: abominations (Literal); detestable practices (Balanced); disgusting practices (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word names what Yahweh finds loathsome. The wording follows 1 Kings 14:24.

decisions.choice: "abominaciones" (L); "prácticas detestables" (B); "prácticas repugnantes" (R)
decisions.reason: One word per level for what Yahweh finds loathsome, following the English levels; Literal keeps "abominaciones", as the published Spanish Literal does elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "quemó a su propio hijo en el fuego como sacrificio"
alternatives: hizo pasar a su hijo por el fuego
decisions.reason: Readable says what "pass through the fire" meant (m2), as the English does; Literal and Balanced keep the phrase.

decisions.choice: "abominations" (L); "pratiques abominables" (B); "pratiques dégoûtantes" (R)
decisions.reason: Each level follows the English choice for the detestable practices of the nations; Readable says plainly that the boy was burned as a sacrifice (m2).

decisions.choice: alimchoma mwanawe mwenyewe motoni kuwa dhabihu
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "passing through the fire" was (meaning decision m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: machukizo (Literal); desturi za kuchukiza (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Machukizo" is the noun for abominations; Balanced and Readable name them as practices, as the English does.

decisions.choice: thiêu chính con trai mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "pass through the fire" meant (m2), as the English does; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: "불 가운데로 지나가게 했다" (L, B); "불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's veiled phrase; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "가증한 일들" (L); "역겨운 관습" (B); "끔찍한 풍습" (R)
decisions.reason: "가증하다" is the familiar church word; Balanced and Readable use everyday words for what God finds detestable.

source.text: וַיְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַיְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּבָּמ֖וֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָע֑וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sacrificed and made smoke at the high places and on the hills and under every tree luxuriant.

en.L: And he sacrificed and burned incense at the high places and on the hills and under every leafy tree.
en.B: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hills and under every leafy tree.
en.R: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the hilltop shrines, on the hills, and under every large, leafy tree.

es.L: Y ofreció sacrificios y quemó incienso en los lugares altos, y sobre las colinas, y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.B: Ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos, en las colinas y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.R: Ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los santuarios sobre las colinas, en los cerros y debajo de todo árbol grande y frondoso.

fr.L: Et il offrait des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux, et sur les collines, et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.B: Il offrait des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux, sur les collines et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.R: Il offrait des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens dans les sanctuaires sur les collines, sur les hauteurs et sous chaque grand arbre au feuillage épais.

sw.L: Naye akatoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu na juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.B: Alitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu, juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.R: Alitoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba katika patakatifu pa kilimani, juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti mkubwa wenye majani mengi.

decisions.choice: made smoke: burned incense or offerings
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke, either incense or parts of an offering. Beside "sacrificed" it describes the worship at the shrines, as at 1 Kings 22:44.

decisions.choice: on the hills and under every leafy tree: the places where the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 12:2 orders Israel to destroy the places where the nations served their gods "on the high mountains and on the hills and under every leafy tree". Judah built such places under Rehoboam (1 Kings 14:23), and the phrase is used again of Israel's worship (17:10).

decisions.choice: he sacrificed: the king himself, not only the people
decisions.reason: Under the good kings before him "the people" still sacrificed at the high places (15:4, 35). Now the king takes part himself.

decisions.choice: high places (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines (Readable); leafy tree
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books, as at 1 Kings 14:23.

decisions.choice: "los lugares altos" (L, B); "los santuarios sobre las colinas" (R); "árbol frondoso"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the high places; "frondoso" for the leafy tree at every level. Readable says "cerros" for the hills so as not to repeat "colinas".

decisions.choice: imparfait "offrait ... brûlait"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes a practice of the king's reign, so French uses the imparfait of repeated action at every level.

records.literal_gloss: Then came up Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel [to] Jerusalem for battle, and they besieged Ahaz, and not they were able to do battle.

en.L: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up [to] Jerusalem for battle, and they besieged Ahaz, but they were not able to fight [it out].
en.B: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war. They besieged Ahaz, but they were not able to take the city.
en.R: Then King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah, who ruled Israel, came to attack Jerusalem. They surrounded Ahaz in the city, but they could not capture it.

es.L: Entonces subieron Rezín, rey de Aram, y Peka hijo de Remalías, rey de Israel, [a] Jerusalén para la guerra, y sitiaron a Acaz, pero no pudieron combatir.
es.B: Entonces Rezín, rey de Aram, y Peka hijo de Remalías, rey de Israel, subieron a Jerusalén para hacer la guerra. Sitiaron a Acaz, pero no pudieron tomar la ciudad.
es.R: Entonces el rey Rezín de Aram y el rey Peka hijo de Remalías, que gobernaba Israel, vinieron a atacar Jerusalén. Rodearon a Acaz en la ciudad, pero no pudieron conquistarla.

fr.L: Alors Retsin, roi d’Aram, et Péqah fils de Remalia, roi d’Israël, montèrent [vers] Jérusalem pour combattre, et ils assiégèrent Achaz, mais ils ne purent pas combattre.
