fr.R: Alors le roi Retsin d’Aram et le roi Péqah fils de Remalia, qui régnait sur Israël, sont venus attaquer Jérusalem. Ils ont encerclé Achaz dans la ville, mais ils n’ont pas réussi à la prendre.

sw.L: Ndipo Resini mfalme wa Aramu na Peka mwana wa Remalia, mfalme wa Israeli, wakapanda [hata] Yerusalemu kwa vita, wakamzingira Ahazi, lakini hawakuweza kupigana [na kushinda].
sw.B: Kisha Resini mfalme wa Aramu na Peka mwana wa Remalia, mfalme wa Israeli, walipanda Yerusalemu kufanya vita. Wakamzingira Ahazi, lakini hawakuweza kuuteka mji.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Resini wa Aramu na mfalme Peka mwana wa Remalia, aliyetawala Israeli, walikuja kuishambulia Yerusalemu. Walimzingira Ahazi ndani ya mji, lakini hawakuweza kuuteka.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Rê-xin vua A-ram và Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để giao chiến; họ vây A-cha, nhưng không thể đánh [thắng].
vi.B: Bấy giờ Rê-xin vua A-ram và Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia vua Y-sơ-ra-ên kéo lên đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ vây hãm A-cha nhưng không chiếm được thành.
vi.R: Bấy giờ vua Rê-xin của A-ram và vua Phê-ca con trai Rê-ma-lia, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, kéo đến tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ vây A-cha trong thành, nhưng không chiếm được thành.

ko.L: 그때 아람 왕 르신과 이스라엘 왕 르말랴의 아들 베가가 전쟁하러 예루살렘으로 올라와 아하스를 에워쌌으나, 싸워 [이길] 수 없었다.
ko.B: 그때 아람 왕 르신과 이스라엘 왕 르말랴의 아들 베가가 예루살렘을 치려고 올라왔다. 그들은 아하스를 에워쌌으나 그 성을 함락시킬 수 없었다.
ko.R: 그때 아람 왕 르신과 이스라엘을 다스리던 르말랴의 아들 베가 왕이 예루살렘을 공격하러 왔다. 그들은 성 안에 있는 아하스를 에워쌌지만, 그 성을 빼앗지 못했다.

decisions.choice: the same attack told in Isaiah 7:1
decisions.reason: Isaiah 7:1 opens with nearly the same words. The differences are small: Isaiah adds "against it" after "for battle", leaves out "they besieged Ahaz", and has "he was not able to fight against it" where Kings has the plural, "they were not able to fight". The wording here follows the translation of Isaiah 7:1 where the Hebrew is the same. Isaiah 7:2-9 tells how the prophet urged Ahaz to stay calm and trust Yahweh during this attack.

decisions.choice: Rezin and Pekah: an alliance against Judah
decisions.reason: Rezin ruled Aram from Damascus and Pekah ruled Israel from Samaria. In the 730s BC, as Assyria pressed west, they marched on Jerusalem; Isaiah 7:6 says they planned to put a king of their own choosing, "the son of Tabeel", on Judah's throne. 2 Chronicles 28:5-8 tells of heavy losses Judah suffered in this war.

decisions.choice: they besieged Ahaz: they shut him up in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: To besiege a king is to surround the city he is in. The king, not only the city, was the target of the attack.

decisions.choice: not able to fight: not able to win the battle
decisions.reason: "Fight" here means to fight the battle through to the end, that is, to take the city. Isaiah 7:1 uses the same verb in this sense.

decisions.choice: take the city / capture it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "fight" means here (m4), as Isaiah 7:1 does. Readable says "King Rezin" and "King Pekah" and "who ruled Israel", as Isaiah 7:1 does; it leaves out "northern kingdom" there, since Kings uses "Israel" for that kingdom throughout.

decisions.choice: "Rezín"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Rezin, kept the same through these books.

source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא הֵ֠שִׁיב רְצִ֨ין מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֤ם אֶת־אֵילַת֙ לַֽאֲרָ֔ם וַיְנַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת־הַיְהוּדִ֖ים מֵֽאֵיל֑וֹת וַֽאֲדוֹמִים֙בָּ֣אוּ אֵילַ֔ת וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that restored Rezin king of Aram Elath to Aram, and he cleared out the Judeans from Eloth; and Edomites came [to] Elath, and they have lived there until the day the this.

en.L: At that time Rezin king of Aram restored Elath to Aram, and he drove the Judeans out of Elath; and Edomites came [to] Elath, and they have lived there to this day.
en.B: At that time Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram and drove the people of Judah out of Elath. Edomites came to Elath, and they have lived there to this day.
en.R: At that time King Rezin of Aram took back the town of Elath for Aram and drove out the people of Judah who lived there. Then Edomites moved into Elath, and they live there to this day.

es.L: En aquel tiempo Rezín, rey de Aram, restituyó Elat a Aram, y echó de Elot a los judíos; y los edomitas vinieron [a] Elat, y han habitado allí hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: En aquel tiempo Rezín, rey de Aram, recuperó Elat para Aram y echó de Elat a la gente de Judá. Los edomitas vinieron a Elat, y han vivido allí hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: En aquel tiempo el rey Rezín de Aram recuperó la ciudad de Elat para Aram y echó a la gente de Judá que vivía allí. Entonces los edomitas se instalaron en Elat, y viven allí hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, Retsin, roi d’Aram, rendit Élath à Aram, et il chassa les Judéens d’Éloth ; et des Édomites vinrent [à] Élath, et ils y ont habité jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, Retsin, roi d’Aram, reprit Élath pour Aram et chassa d’Élath les gens de Juda. Des Édomites vinrent à Élath, et ils y habitent jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: À cette époque, le roi Retsin d’Aram a repris la ville d’Élath pour Aram, et il a chassé les gens de Juda qui y vivaient. Puis des Édomites sont venus s’installer à Élath, et ils y vivent encore aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Wakati huo Resini mfalme wa Aramu aliirudisha Elathi kwa Aramu, akawafukuza Wayuda kutoka Elothi; na Waedomu wakaja [hata] Elathi, nao wamekaa huko mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Wakati huo Resini mfalme wa Aramu aliirudishia Aramu mji wa Elathi, akawafukuza watu wa Yuda kutoka Elathi. Waedomu wakaja Elathi, nao wamekaa huko mpaka leo.
sw.R: Wakati huo mfalme Resini wa Aramu aliutwaa tena mji wa Elathi kwa ajili ya Aramu, akawafukuza watu wa Yuda waliokuwa wakiishi huko. Kisha Waedomu wakahamia Elathi, nao wanaishi huko mpaka leo.

vi.L: Lúc ấy Rê-xin vua A-ram khôi phục Ê-lát cho A-ram, và đuổi người Giu-đa ra khỏi Ê-lốt; người Ê-đôm đến Ê-lát và ở đó cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Lúc ấy Rê-xin vua A-ram thu hồi Ê-lát cho A-ram và đuổi dân Giu-đa ra khỏi Ê-lát. Người Ê-đôm đến Ê-lát và sống ở đó cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Lúc ấy vua Rê-xin của A-ram lấy lại thành Ê-lát cho A-ram và đuổi dân Giu-đa sống ở đó đi. Rồi người Ê-đôm đến ở Ê-lát, và họ sống ở đó cho đến ngày nay.

ko.L: 그때에 아람 왕 르신이 엘랏을 아람에 되돌리고, 유다 사람들을 엘랏에서 몰아냈다. 그리고 에돔 사람들이 엘랏에 와서 오늘날까지 거기에서 살고 있다.
ko.B: 그때에 아람 왕 르신은 엘랏을 되찾아 아람에 돌려주고, 유다 사람들을 엘랏에서 몰아냈다. 그리고 에돔 사람들이 엘랏에 와서 오늘날까지 거기에서 살고 있다.
ko.R: 그때에 아람 왕 르신은 엘랏 성읍을 되찾아 아람 땅으로 만들고, 그곳에 살던 유다 사람들을 쫓아냈다. 그 뒤에 에돔 사람들이 엘랏으로 옮겨 와서 오늘날까지 그곳에서 살고 있다.

decisions.choice: Edomites: the reading of the Hebrew tradition; "Aram" kept earlier in the verse
alternatives: the king of Edom recovered Elath for Edom
Arameans came to Elath (the written text)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text reads "Arameans" at the end of the verse; the tradition of reading it aloud reads "Edomites", which is followed here. In Hebrew the names Aram and Edom differ by only one letter, and two letters that look much alike. Elath lay at the head of the gulf of the Red Sea, far from Aram and next to Edom, and it had been taken from Edom (14:7, 22). For this reason many think the verse first said that the king of Edom recovered Elath "for Edom", and that "Rezin king of Aram" and "Aram" came in through copying. Every level keeps the Hebrew "Rezin king of Aram ... for Aram"; reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: Elath: Judah's port on the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Elath stood at the head of the Gulf of Aqaba, near Ezion-geber where Solomon kept his ships (1 Kings 9:26). Azariah of Judah had rebuilt it and restored it to Judah (14:22). "Restored" here takes up that word: Elath now changes hands again. Losing it cut Judah off from the trade of the Red Sea.

decisions.choice: the Judeans: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: This is the first time the word for "Judeans", later "Jews", appears in the Hebrew Bible. Here it means the people of the kingdom of Judah who lived in Elath.

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own time
decisions.reason: As at 2:22, "to this day" means up to the time when the account was written: Elath was still in Edomite hands then.

decisions.choice: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the people of Judah" so that readers do not take the word in its later sense of the Jewish people as a whole. Literal keeps "Judeans".

decisions.choice: "la gente de Judá"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "la gente de Judá" so the word is not taken in its later sense, as the English does; Literal keeps "los judíos".

decisions.choice: Elothi; Wayuda
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's second spelling of the town, Eloth, and its word for the people of Judah; Balanced and Readable use one spelling and say "watu wa Yuda".

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אָחָ֜ז מַלְאָכִ֗ים אֶל־תִּ֠גְלַת פְּלֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עַבְדְּךָ֥ וּבִנְךָ֖ אָ֑נִי עֲלֵ֨ה וְהוֹשִׁעֵ֜נִי מִכַּ֣ף מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֗ם וּמִכַּף֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַקּוֹמִ֖ים עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Ahaz messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, your servant and your son [am] I; come up and save me from [the] palm of [the] king of Aram and from [the] palm of [the] king of Israel, the [ones] rising up against me.

en.L: And Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, "Your servant and your son [am] I. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Aram and from the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising up against me."
en.B: Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria with this message: "I am your servant and your son. Come up and rescue me from the power of the king of Aram and the king of Israel, who are attacking me."
en.R: Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser, the king of Assyria, with this message: "I am your servant and your son. Come and save me from the king of Aram and the king of Israel. They are attacking me."

es.L: Y Acaz envió mensajeros a Tiglat-piléser, rey de Asiria, diciendo: «Tu siervo y tu hijo [soy] yo; sube y sálvame de la palma del rey de Aram y de la palma del rey de Israel, que se levantan contra mí».
es.B: Acaz envió mensajeros a Tiglat-piléser, rey de Asiria, con este mensaje: «Yo soy tu siervo y tu hijo. Sube y líbrame del poder del rey de Aram y del rey de Israel, que me atacan».
es.R: Acaz envió mensajeros a Tiglat-piléser, el rey de Asiria, con este mensaje: «Yo soy tu siervo y tu hijo. Ven a salvarme del rey de Aram y del rey de Israel. Me están atacando».

fr.L: Et Achaz envoya des messagers à Tiglath-Piléser, roi d’Assyrie, pour dire : « Ton serviteur et ton fils, [c’est] moi. Monte et sauve-moi de la main du roi d’Aram et de la main du roi d’Israël, qui se dressent contre moi. »
fr.B: Achaz envoya des messagers à Tiglath-Piléser, roi d’Assyrie, avec ce message : « Je suis ton serviteur et ton fils. Monte me délivrer du pouvoir du roi d’Aram et du roi d’Israël, qui m’attaquent. »
fr.R: Achaz a envoyé des messagers à Tiglath-Piléser, le roi d’Assyrie, avec ce message : « Je suis ton serviteur et ton fils. Viens me sauver du roi d’Aram et du roi d’Israël. Ils m’attaquent. »

sw.L: Naye Ahazi akatuma wajumbe kwa Tiglath-pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru, akisema, "Mimi ni mtumishi wako na mwana wako. Panda uniokoe kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme wa Aramu na kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme wa Israeli, wanaoinuka juu yangu."
sw.B: Ahazi alituma wajumbe kwa Tiglath-pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru na ujumbe huu: "Mimi ni mtumishi wako na mwana wako. Njoo uniokoe kutoka katika nguvu za mfalme wa Aramu na mfalme wa Israeli, wanaonishambulia."
sw.R: Ahazi alituma wajumbe kwa Tiglath-pileseri, mfalme wa Ashuru, na ujumbe huu: "Mimi ni mtumishi wako na mwana wako. Njoo uniokoe kutoka kwa mfalme wa Aramu na mfalme wa Israeli. Wananishambulia."

vi.L: A-cha sai sứ giả đến Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se vua A-si-ri, nói: "Tôi [là] đầy tớ của vua và con của vua. Xin hãy đi lên và cứu tôi khỏi tay vua A-ram và khỏi tay vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những kẻ đang nổi lên chống lại tôi."
vi.B: A-cha sai sứ giả đến Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se vua A-si-ri với lời nhắn: "Tôi là đầy tớ của vua và là con của vua. Xin vua đi lên giải cứu tôi khỏi quyền lực của vua A-ram và vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những kẻ đang tấn công tôi."
vi.R: A-cha sai sứ giả đến Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se, vua A-si-ri, với lời nhắn: "Tôi là đầy tớ của vua và là con của vua. Xin vua đến cứu tôi khỏi vua A-ram và vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúng đang tấn công tôi."

ko.L: 그리고 아하스가 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀에게 사자들을 보내어 말했다. "저는 임금님의 종이요 임금님의 아들입니다. 올라오셔서, 저를 대적하여 일어난 아람 왕의 손바닥과 이스라엘 왕의 손바닥에서 저를 구원해 주십시오."
ko.B: 아하스는 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀에게 사자들을 보내어 이렇게 전했다. "저는 임금님의 종이며 임금님의 아들입니다. 올라오셔서, 저를 치고 있는 아람 왕과 이스라엘 왕의 손에서 저를 구해 주십시오."
ko.R: 아하스는 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀에게 사자들을 보내어 이렇게 전했다. "저는 임금님의 종이며 임금님의 아들입니다. 오셔서 아람 왕과 이스라엘 왕에게서 저를 구해 주십시오. 그들이 저를 공격하고 있습니다."

decisions.choice: Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria
decisions.reason: Tiglath-pileser III ruled Assyria from 745 to 727 BC and pushed its empire west to the Mediterranean. He is also called Pul (15:19), and he had already taken towns of northern Israel in Pekah's reign (15:29).

decisions.choice: your servant and your son: the words of a vassal to his overlord
decisions.reason: A king who calls himself another king's servant and son places himself under him as a subject king, owing loyalty and tribute. Ahaz offers Judah's submission to Assyria in return for help.

decisions.choice: son ... save me: help sought from Assyria rather than from Yahweh
decisions.reason: Yahweh had promised that David's heir would be a son to him (2 Samuel 7:14), and through Isaiah he told Ahaz not to fear these two kings but to trust him (Isaiah 7:4, 9). Ahaz instead calls himself the Assyrian king's son and asks him to save.

decisions.choice: from the palm of: from the power of
decisions.reason: The hand or palm stands for power or control. Rising up against someone means attacking him.

decisions.choice: your servant at every level
decisions.reason: As in other polite or submissive self-references, "your servant" stands at every level. Here it is the formal language of a subject king (m2), and "slave" would suggest a household slave rather than a vassal.

decisions.choice: save me from the king of Aram and the king of Israel. They are attacking me.
decisions.reason: Readable leaves out the picture of the hand (m4) and puts "rising up against me" in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "tu siervo" at every level; "tú" to the king of Assyria
decisions.reason: "Tu siervo" stands at every level, as the Samuel terms note sets for a subject speaking to a king; Spanish uses "tú" to kings and never "usted", and the submission is carried by "siervo" and "hijo" (m2).

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level
decisions.reason: A vassal's words to his overlord (m2); as the English and the Samuel note for "your servant" in speech to a king, "serviteur" serves at every level, Literal included.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wako at every level
decisions.reason: A vassal speaking to his overlord, in the wording used for "your servant" to a king in Samuel.

decisions.choice: tôi ... đầy tớ của vua và con của vua
decisions.reason: Ahaz writes as a vassal: "đầy tớ của vua" stands at every level, as the English keeps "your servant", and he says "tôi" rather than the court's "bệ hạ", since he is himself a king.

decisions.choice: Ahaz writes to the king of Assyria in the formal style (합쇼체), calling himself "저" and "임금님의 종"
decisions.reason: "Your servant and your son" are the words of a vassal to his overlord (meaning decision m2); Korean shows the submission by the speech level as well as by the words.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אָחָ֜ז אֶת־הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֗ב הַנִּמְצָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח לְמֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֖וּר שֹֽׁחַד׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Ahaz the silver and the gold found [in the] house of Yahweh and in [the] treasuries of [the] house of the king, and he sent to [the] king of Assyria a bribe.

en.L: And Ahaz took the silver and the gold that was found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the treasuries of the house of the king, and he sent [it] to the king of Assyria [as] a bribe.
en.B: Ahaz took the silver and gold to be found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the palace treasuries, and he sent it as a bribe to the king of Assyria.
en.R: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in the treasure rooms of the royal palace. He sent it to the king of Assyria as a bribe.

es.L: Y Acaz tomó la plata y el oro que se halló en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros de la casa del rey, y [lo] envió al rey de Asiria [como] soborno.
es.B: Acaz tomó la plata y el oro que había en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en los tesoros del palacio, y se lo envió como soborno al rey de Asiria.
es.R: Acaz tomó la plata y el oro que había en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en las salas del tesoro del palacio real. Se lo envió al rey de Asiria como soborno.

fr.L: Et Achaz prit l’argent et l’or qui se trouvaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors de la maison du roi, et il [l’]envoya au roi d’Assyrie [comme] présent corrupteur.
fr.B: Achaz prit l’argent et l’or qui se trouvaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les trésors du palais, et il les envoya au roi d’Assyrie pour l’acheter.
fr.R: Achaz a pris l’argent et l’or qui se trouvaient dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans les salles du trésor du palais royal. Il les a envoyés au roi d’Assyrie pour l’acheter.

sw.L: Naye Ahazi akaichukua fedha na dhahabu iliyoonekana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za nyumba ya mfalme, akaipeleka kwa mfalme wa Ashuru [kuwa] rushwa.
sw.B: Ahazi alichukua fedha na dhahabu iliyopatikana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika hazina za ikulu, akaipeleka kwa mfalme wa Ashuru kuwa rushwa.
sw.R: Ahazi alichukua fedha na dhahabu iliyokuwa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika vyumba vya hazina vya jumba la mfalme. Akaipeleka kwa mfalme wa Ashuru kuwa rushwa.

vi.L: A-cha lấy bạc và vàng tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các kho báu của cung vua, và gửi [làm] của hối lộ cho vua A-si-ri.
vi.B: A-cha lấy bạc và vàng có trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong kho báu hoàng cung, gửi làm của hối lộ cho vua A-si-ri.
vi.R: A-cha lấy bạc và vàng có trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong các phòng chứa báu vật của hoàng cung. Ông gửi số ấy cho vua A-si-ri làm của hối lộ.

ko.L: 그리고 아하스가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕의 집 보물 창고들에서 발견된 은과 금을 가져다가 앗시리아 왕에게 뇌물로 보냈다.
ko.B: 아하스는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕궁 보물 창고에 있는 은과 금을 가져다가 앗시리아 왕에게 뇌물로 보냈다.
ko.R: 아하스는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁 보물 창고에 있던 은과 금을 가져갔다. 그는 그것을 앗시리아 왕에게 뇌물로 보냈다.

decisions.choice: bribe: a payment to buy someone's action
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a bribe that bends a judge (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19), not a friendly gift. Asa used the same word when he paid Ben-hadad to break a treaty (1 Kings 15:19). Ahaz buys Assyria's help with the temple's wealth.

decisions.choice: emptying the treasuries: as Asa and Jehoash had done
decisions.reason: Asa sent the treasures of the temple and the palace to Damascus to buy help against Israel (1 Kings 15:18), and Jehoash of Judah paid off Hazael with them (12:19). Now Ahaz pays Assyria to strike Damascus.

decisions.choice: found: what was there
decisions.reason: "Found" means whatever was on hand at the time in the temple and the royal treasuries.

decisions.choice: the temple of the LORD; treasure rooms of the royal palace
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for the house of Yahweh and "royal palace" for the house of the king, as these books do.

decisions.choice: "la casa del SEÑOR" (L, B); "el templo del SEÑOR" (R); "palacio" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the house of the LORD; Balanced and Readable name the king's house as the palace.

decisions.choice: "présent corrupteur" (L); "pour l'acheter" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is a payment that buys someone's action (m1); "pot-de-vin" sounds too modern and petty for a tribute between kings, so Balanced and Readable say what the gift was for.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּעַל֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֶל־דַּמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ וַֽיִּתְפְּשֶׂ֔הָ וַיַּגְלֶ֖הָ קִ֑ירָה וְאֶת־רְצִ֖ין הֵמִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And listened to him [the] king of Assyria, and went up [the] king of Assyria to Damascus and seized it, and he exiled it [to] Kir, and Rezin he put to death.

en.L: And the king of Assyria listened to him, and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and seized it, and he carried it [into exile to] Kir, and he put Rezin to death.
en.B: The king of Assyria agreed to his request. He marched up against Damascus and captured it. He took its people into exile to Kir and put Rezin to death.
en.R: The king of Assyria agreed to help Ahaz. He attacked Damascus and captured it. He forced its people to move to Kir as captives, and he killed Rezin.

es.L: Y el rey de Asiria lo escuchó, y subió el rey de Asiria contra Damasco y la tomó, y la llevó cautiva [a] Quir, y dio muerte a Rezín.
es.B: El rey de Asiria accedió a su petición. Subió contra Damasco y la conquistó. Llevó cautivos a sus habitantes a Quir y dio muerte a Rezín.
es.R: El rey de Asiria aceptó ayudar a Acaz. Atacó Damasco y la conquistó. Obligó a sus habitantes a irse a Quir como prisioneros, y mató a Rezín.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Assyrie l’écouta, et le roi d’Assyrie monta contre Damas et la prit, et il la déporta [à] Qir, et il fit mourir Retsin.
fr.B: Le roi d’Assyrie accéda à sa demande. Il monta contre Damas et s’en empara. Il en déporta les habitants à Qir et fit mourir Retsin.
fr.R: Le roi d’Assyrie a accepté d’aider Achaz. Il a attaqué Damas et l’a prise. Il a obligé ses habitants à partir comme prisonniers à Qir, et il a tué Retsin.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Ashuru akamsikiliza, na mfalme wa Ashuru akapanda juu ya Dameski, akaitwaa, akaihamisha [mpaka] Kiri, naye akamwua Resini.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Ashuru alikubali ombi lake. Akapanda kuishambulia Dameski, akaiteka. Akawachukua watu wake uhamishoni mpaka Kiri, akamwua Resini.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Ashuru alikubali kumsaidia Ahazi. Aliishambulia Dameski, akaiteka. Aliwalazimisha watu wake kuhamia Kiri wakiwa mateka, naye akamwua Resini.

vi.L: Vua A-si-ri nghe lời ông; vua A-si-ri đi lên đánh Đa-mách và chiếm lấy, bắt [dân] nó lưu đày [đến] Ki-rơ, và giết Rê-xin.
vi.B: Vua A-si-ri chấp thuận lời yêu cầu của A-cha. Vua ấy tiến đánh Đa-mách và chiếm được thành, bắt dân thành lưu đày đến Ki-rơ và xử tử Rê-xin.
vi.R: Vua A-si-ri đồng ý giúp A-cha. Vua ấy tấn công Đa-mách và chiếm được thành. Vua ấy bắt dân thành phải dời đến Ki-rơ làm tù binh, và giết Rê-xin.

ko.L: 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 그의 말을 들었다. 그리고 앗시리아 왕이 다메섹으로 올라가 그곳을 점령하고, 그곳을 기르로 사로잡아 갔으며, 르신을 죽였다.
ko.B: 앗시리아 왕은 그의 청을 들어주었다. 그는 다메섹으로 올라가 그 성을 점령하고, 그 백성을 기르로 사로잡아 갔으며, 르신을 죽였다.
ko.R: 앗시리아 왕은 아하스를 도와주기로 했다. 그는 다메섹을 공격하여 빼앗았다. 그는 그곳 백성을 포로로 잡아 기르로 옮겨 살게 했고, 르신을 죽였다.

decisions.choice: listened to him: agreed to his request
decisions.reason: To listen to a request is to agree to it and act on it, as at 1 Kings 15:20.

decisions.choice: the fall of Damascus: the end of the kingdom of Aram
decisions.reason: Damascus fell to Assyria in 732 BC. Its king was killed and its land became part of the Assyrian empire. Isaiah had foretold that Damascus would be plundered before the child of the sign could speak (Isaiah 8:4; 7:16).

decisions.choice: Kir: where the Arameans came from
decisions.reason: Amos had foretold that the people of Aram would go into exile to Kir (Amos 1:5), and he names Kir as the place from which Yahweh brought the Arameans (Amos 9:7). They are sent back where their history began. Where Kir lay is not known.

decisions.choice: exiled it: carried off its people
decisions.reason: "It" refers to the city, meaning its people. Assyria moved conquered peoples to distant lands to break their resistance (17:6).

decisions.choice: its people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who was carried off (m4). Readable also says "agreed to help Ahaz" and explains exile as being forced to move as captives.

decisions.choice: "a sus habitantes"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who was carried off (m4); Literal keeps "la llevó cautiva", with the city as object. "Quir" is the usual Spanish form of Kir.

source.text: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֡ז לִ֠קְרַאת תִּגְלַ֨ת פִּלְאֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ דּוּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּדַמָּ֑שֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶל־אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶת־דְּמ֧וּת הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִית֖וֹ לְכָֽל־מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the king Ahaz to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria [at] Damascus, and he saw the altar which [was] in Damascus; and sent the king Ahaz to Uriah the priest [the] likeness of the altar and its pattern, for all its workmanship.

en.L: And King Ahaz went to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria [at] Damascus, and he saw the altar that [was] in Damascus. And King Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest the likeness of the altar and its pattern, for all its workmanship.
en.B: King Ahaz went to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria at Damascus. There he saw the altar that stood in Damascus. Then King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest a model and a design of the altar, with all the details of how it was made.
en.R: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser, the king of Assyria. While he was there, he saw the altar in Damascus. He sent Uriah the priest a model of the altar and a plan that showed exactly how it was made.

es.L: Y fue el rey Acaz al encuentro de Tiglat-piléser, rey de Asiria, [a] Damasco, y vio el altar que [estaba] en Damasco. Y el rey Acaz envió al sacerdote Urías la imagen del altar y su modelo, conforme a toda su hechura.
es.B: El rey Acaz fue a Damasco al encuentro de Tiglat-piléser, rey de Asiria. Allí vio el altar que había en Damasco. Entonces el rey Acaz le envió al sacerdote Urías una maqueta y un diseño del altar, con todos los detalles de su construcción.
es.R: El rey Acaz fue a Damasco para encontrarse con Tiglat-piléser, el rey de Asiria. Mientras estaba allí, vio el altar de Damasco. Le envió al sacerdote Urías una maqueta del altar y un plano que mostraba exactamente cómo estaba hecho.

fr.L: Et le roi Achaz alla à la rencontre de Tiglath-Piléser, roi d’Assyrie, [à] Damas, et il vit l’autel qui [était] à Damas. Et le roi Achaz envoya au prêtre Urie la forme de l’autel et son modèle, selon toute sa fabrication.
fr.B: Le roi Achaz alla à Damas au-devant de Tiglath-Piléser, roi d’Assyrie. Là, il vit l’autel qui se trouvait à Damas. Alors le roi Achaz envoya au prêtre Urie une maquette et un plan de l’autel, avec tous les détails de sa fabrication.
fr.R: Le roi Achaz est allé à Damas pour rencontrer Tiglath-Piléser, le roi d’Assyrie. Pendant qu’il était là-bas, il a vu l’autel de Damas. Il a envoyé au prêtre Urie une maquette de l’autel et un plan qui montrait exactement comment le construire.

sw.L: Naye mfalme Ahazi akaenda kumlaki Tiglath-pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru [huko] Dameski, akaiona madhabahu iliyokuwa huko Dameski. Naye mfalme Ahazi akampelekea Uria kuhani mfano wa madhabahu hiyo na ramani yake, kwa kazi yake yote.
sw.B: Mfalme Ahazi alikwenda kukutana na Tiglath-pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru huko Dameski. Huko akaiona madhabahu iliyokuwa Dameski. Kisha mfalme Ahazi akampelekea Uria kuhani mfano na ramani ya madhabahu hiyo, pamoja na maelezo yote ya jinsi ilivyotengenezwa.
sw.R: Mfalme Ahazi alikwenda Dameski kukutana na Tiglath-pileseri, mfalme wa Ashuru. Alipokuwa huko, aliiona madhabahu ya Dameski. Akampelekea Uria kuhani mfano wa madhabahu hiyo na ramani iliyoonyesha hasa jinsi ilivyotengenezwa.

vi.L: Vua A-cha đi gặp Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se vua A-si-ri [tại] Đa-mách, và thấy bàn thờ ở Đa-mách. Vua A-cha gửi cho thầy tế lễ U-ri hình dạng của bàn thờ và kiểu mẫu của nó, theo mọi chi tiết cách làm.
vi.B: Vua A-cha đi đến Đa-mách để gặp Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se vua A-si-ri. Tại đó vua thấy bàn thờ ở Đa-mách. Vua A-cha liền gửi cho thầy tế lễ U-ri một mô hình và bản vẽ của bàn thờ ấy, với mọi chi tiết về cách làm.
vi.R: Vua A-cha đi đến Đa-mách để gặp Tiếc-la-Phi-lê-se, vua A-si-ri. Khi ở đó, vua thấy bàn thờ tại Đa-mách. Vua gửi cho thầy tế lễ U-ri một mô hình của bàn thờ ấy và một bản vẽ chỉ rõ cách làm.

ko.L: 그리고 아하스 왕이 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀을 만나러 다메섹에 갔다가, 다메섹에 있는 제단을 보았다. 그리고 아하스 왕이 그 제단의 모양과 그 양식을, 그 모든 만듦새대로 제사장 우리야에게 보냈다.
ko.B: 아하스 왕은 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀을 만나러 다메섹에 갔다. 거기에서 그는 다메섹에 있는 제단을 보았다. 그러자 아하스 왕은 그 제단의 모형과 설계도를 그 세부 구조까지 모두 그려서 제사장 우리야에게 보냈다.
ko.R: 아하스 왕은 앗시리아 왕 디글랏빌레셀을 만나러 다메섹으로 갔다. 거기에 있는 동안 그는 다메섹에 있는 제단을 보았다. 그는 제사장 우리야에게 그 제단의 모형과, 그것을 어떻게 만드는지 자세히 보여 주는 설계도를 보냈다.

decisions.choice: went to meet the king of Assyria: a subject king presenting himself
decisions.reason: Ahaz goes to the conquered city of Damascus to appear before his new overlord, as subject kings were required to do.

decisions.choice: the altar in Damascus: a foreign altar
decisions.reason: The text does not say whose altar it was, an Aramean one or one the Assyrians set up, or to which god it belonged. What matters to the writer is that the new altar of Yahweh's temple is copied from it.

decisions.choice: likeness and pattern: a design from Damascus instead of from Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word "pattern" is the one used for the pattern of the tabernacle and its furnishings that Yahweh showed Moses (Exodus 25:9, 40), and for the plan of the temple David gave Solomon (1 Chronicles 28:11-19). Here the pattern for the altar comes from a foreign city.

decisions.choice: Uriah the priest: the chief priest at the temple
decisions.reason: Uriah appears to be the leading priest in Jerusalem. Isaiah names "Uriah the priest" as a reliable witness (Isaiah 8:2), most likely the same man.

decisions.choice: a model ... its design / a plan; with all the details of how it was made
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "model" for "likeness" and "design" or "plan" for "pattern", and turn "for all its workmanship" into a plain phrase. Readable adds "While he was there" to link the two events.

decisions.choice: "una maqueta y un diseño" (B); "una maqueta ... y un plano" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "likeness" and "pattern" were, a model and a design, as the English does; Literal keeps "imagen" and "modelo". "Urías" is the usual Spanish form.

source.text: וַיִּ֛בֶן אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז מִדַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַד־בּ֥וֹא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־אָחָ֖ז מִדַּמָּֽשֶׂק׃

records.literal_gloss: And built Uriah the priest the altar according to all that had sent the king Ahaz from Damascus; so did Uriah the priest until [the] coming of the king Ahaz from Damascus.

en.L: And Uriah the priest built the altar according to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus; so Uriah the priest did, until King Ahaz came from Damascus.
en.B: Uriah the priest built the altar following everything King Ahaz had sent from Damascus. He had it finished by the time King Ahaz came back from Damascus.
en.R: Uriah the priest built the altar exactly like the model and plan King Ahaz had sent from Damascus. He finished it before King Ahaz came home.

es.L: Y el sacerdote Urías edificó el altar conforme a todo lo que el rey Acaz había enviado de Damasco; así lo hizo el sacerdote Urías, hasta que vino el rey Acaz de Damasco.
es.B: El sacerdote Urías construyó el altar siguiendo todo lo que el rey Acaz le había enviado de Damasco. Lo tuvo terminado para cuando el rey Acaz volvió de Damasco.
es.R: El sacerdote Urías construyó el altar exactamente igual que la maqueta y el plano que el rey Acaz le había enviado de Damasco. Lo terminó antes de que el rey Acaz regresara.

fr.L: Et le prêtre Urie bâtit l’autel selon tout ce que le roi Achaz avait envoyé de Damas ; ainsi fit le prêtre Urie, jusqu’à ce que le roi Achaz revienne de Damas.
fr.B: Le prêtre Urie construisit l’autel en suivant tout ce que le roi Achaz avait envoyé de Damas. Il l’eut achevé avant que le roi Achaz revienne de Damas.
fr.R: Le prêtre Urie a construit l’autel exactement d’après la maquette et le plan que le roi Achaz avait envoyés de Damas. Il l’a terminé avant le retour du roi.

sw.L: Naye Uria kuhani akaijenga madhabahu sawasawa na yote aliyoyatuma mfalme Ahazi kutoka Dameski; ndivyo alivyofanya Uria kuhani, hata kuja kwa mfalme Ahazi kutoka Dameski.
sw.B: Uria kuhani aliijenga madhabahu akifuata kila kitu mfalme Ahazi alichokuwa amekituma kutoka Dameski. Alikuwa ameimaliza kabla mfalme Ahazi hajarudi kutoka Dameski.
sw.R: Uria kuhani aliijenga madhabahu sawasawa kabisa na mfano na ramani ambayo mfalme Ahazi alikuwa ametuma kutoka Dameski. Aliimaliza kabla mfalme Ahazi hajarudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ U-ri xây bàn thờ theo mọi điều vua A-cha đã gửi từ Đa-mách; thầy tế lễ U-ri làm như vậy cho đến khi vua A-cha từ Đa-mách về.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ U-ri xây bàn thờ theo đúng mọi điều vua A-cha đã gửi từ Đa-mách. Ông làm xong trước khi vua A-cha từ Đa-mách trở về.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ U-ri xây bàn thờ đúng như mô hình và bản vẽ vua A-cha đã gửi từ Đa-mách. Ông làm xong trước khi vua A-cha về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 우리야가 아하스 왕이 다메섹에서 보낸 모든 것대로 제단을 쌓았다. 아하스 왕이 다메섹에서 올 때까지 제사장 우리야가 그렇게 했다.
ko.B: 제사장 우리야는 아하스 왕이 다메섹에서 보낸 대로 모든 것을 따라 제단을 쌓았다. 그는 아하스 왕이 다메섹에서 돌아오기 전에 그 일을 마쳤다.
ko.R: 제사장 우리야는 아하스 왕이 다메섹에서 보낸 모형과 설계도와 똑같이 제단을 쌓았다. 그는 아하스 왕이 돌아오기 전에 그 일을 끝냈다.

decisions.choice: so Uriah did until the king came: the work was done before the king returned
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse repeats that Uriah followed the king's instructions, and adds that he did so in the time before Ahaz came back. The altar was ready when he arrived (verse 12).

decisions.choice: according to all that the king had sent: the priest follows the king's design
decisions.reason: The words "according to all that" are used of the builders of the tabernacle, who made everything as Yahweh had commanded Moses (Exodus 39:42). Here the priest builds by the king's command, from a pattern that came from Damascus (verse 10).

decisions.choice: had it finished by the time ... came back / finished it before ... came home
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "so he did until the king came" means (m1). Readable also says "the model and plan" for "all that the king had sent" (verse 10).

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מִדַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַיַּ֥רְא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּקְרַ֥ב הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And came the king from Damascus, and saw the king the altar, and drew near the king to the altar, and he offered up on it.

en.L: And the king came from Damascus, and the king saw the altar, and the king drew near to the altar and offered [sacrifices] on it.
en.B: On his return from Damascus the king saw the altar; he approached it and offered sacrifices on it.
en.R: The king came home from Damascus and saw the altar. He went up to it and offered sacrifices on it.

es.L: Y vino el rey de Damasco, y el rey vio el altar, y el rey se acercó al altar y ofreció [sacrificios] sobre él.
es.B: Cuando el rey volvió de Damasco, vio el altar; se acercó a él y ofreció sacrificios sobre él.
es.R: El rey regresó de Damasco y vio el altar. Se acercó a él y ofreció sacrificios sobre él.

fr.L: Et le roi revint de Damas, et le roi vit l’autel, et le roi s’approcha de l’autel et y offrit [des sacrifices].
fr.B: À son retour de Damas, le roi vit l’autel ; il s’en approcha et y offrit des sacrifices.
fr.R: Le roi est rentré de Damas et il a vu l’autel. Il s’en est approché et il y a offert des sacrifices.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akaja kutoka Dameski, naye mfalme akaiona madhabahu, naye mfalme akaikaribia madhabahu, akatoa [dhabihu] juu yake.
sw.B: Mfalme aliporudi kutoka Dameski aliiona madhabahu; akaikaribia, akatoa dhabihu juu yake.
sw.R: Mfalme alirudi nyumbani kutoka Dameski, akaiona madhabahu. Akaikaribia, akatoa dhabihu juu yake.

vi.L: Vua từ Đa-mách về, vua thấy bàn thờ, vua đến gần bàn thờ và dâng [sinh tế] trên đó.
vi.B: Khi từ Đa-mách trở về, vua thấy bàn thờ; vua đến gần và dâng sinh tế trên đó.
vi.R: Vua từ Đa-mách về nhà và thấy bàn thờ. Vua đến gần và dâng sinh tế trên đó.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 다메섹에서 와서, 왕이 그 제단을 보았다. 그리고 왕이 그 제단에 가까이 가서 그 위에 [제물을] 바쳤다.
ko.B: 왕은 다메섹에서 돌아와 그 제단을 보고, 제단으로 나아가 그 위에 제물을 바쳤다.
ko.R: 왕은 다메섹에서 돌아와 그 제단을 보았다. 그는 제단으로 올라가 그 위에 제물을 바쳤다.

decisions.choice: offered on it: or "went up on it"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew letters can be read as "he went up on it", climbing the altar's steps or ramp, or as "he offered up on it", making offerings rise on it. The vowels of the Hebrew text give "offered up", and verse 13 says what he offered. Either way Ahaz himself served at the altar.

decisions.choice: the king at the altar: Ahaz acts as priest
decisions.reason: The word "king" is repeated three times: it is the king who sees, approaches and offers. Kings had offered sacrifices at great occasions before (1 Kings 8:62-64), but Jeroboam's offering at his own altar is the closest parallel (1 Kings 12:33). 2 Chronicles 26:16-21 tells how Uzziah was struck with skin disease for burning incense in the temple.

decisions.choice: On his return ... the king saw the altar; he approached it ... / The king came home ... He went up to it ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join the four short clauses into fewer sentences and say "the king" once. Literal keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: sacrifices
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; English needs one. Literal puts it in brackets.

source.text: וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר אֶת־עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־מִנְחָת֔וֹ וַיַּסֵּ֖ךְ אֶת־נִסְכּ֑וֹ וַיִּזְרֹ֛ק אֶת־דַּֽם־הַשְּׁלָמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made smoke his burnt offering and his grain offering, and he poured out his drink offering, and he dashed [the] blood of the peace offerings which [were] his on the altar.

en.L: And he burned his burnt offering and his grain offering, and he poured out his drink offering, and he dashed the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
en.B: He burned his burnt offering and grain offering, poured his drink offering, and splashed the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
en.R: He burned his burnt offering and his grain offering on it. He poured out his drink offering and splashed the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

es.L: Y quemó su holocausto y su ofrenda de cereal, y derramó su libación, y roció la sangre de sus sacrificios de paz sobre el altar.
es.B: Quemó su holocausto y su ofrenda de cereal, derramó su libación y roció sobre el altar la sangre de sus sacrificios de paz.
es.R: Quemó sobre él su holocausto y su ofrenda de cereal. Derramó su ofrenda de vino y roció sobre el altar la sangre de sus sacrificios de paz.

fr.L: Et il fit brûler son holocauste et son offrande végétale, et il versa sa libation, et il aspergea le sang de ses sacrifices de communion sur l’autel.
fr.B: Il fit brûler son holocauste et son offrande végétale, versa sa libation et aspergea l’autel du sang de ses sacrifices de communion.
fr.R: Il y a fait brûler son holocauste et son offrande végétale. Il a versé sa libation et il a aspergé l’autel avec le sang de ses sacrifices de communion.

sw.L: Naye akaiteketeza sadaka yake ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya nafaka, akaimimina sadaka yake ya kinywaji, akayanyunyiza damu ya sadaka zake za amani juu ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Akaiteketeza sadaka yake ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka, akamimina sadaka yake ya kinywaji, akairushia madhabahu damu ya sadaka zake za amani.
sw.R: Aliteketeza juu yake sadaka yake ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya nafaka. Akamimina sadaka yake ya kinywaji, akarushia madhabahu damu ya sadaka zake za amani.

vi.L: Vua thiêu của lễ thiêu và tế lễ chay của mình, đổ lễ quán của mình, và rảy huyết các tế lễ bình an của mình trên bàn thờ.
vi.B: Vua thiêu của lễ thiêu và tế lễ chay, đổ lễ quán, và vẩy huyết các tế lễ bình an của mình trên bàn thờ.
vi.R: Vua thiêu của lễ thiêu và tế lễ chay của mình trên đó. Vua đổ lễ quán ra và vẩy huyết các tế lễ bình an của mình trên bàn thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 번제물과 그의 곡식 제물을 불살랐고, 그의 부어 드리는 제물을 부었으며, 그의 화목제물의 피를 제단 위에 뿌렸다.
ko.B: 그는 번제물과 곡식 제물을 불사르고, 부어 드리는 제물을 붓고, 화목제물의 피를 제단에 뿌렸다.
ko.R: 그는 그 제단 위에서 번제물과 곡식 제물을 불살랐다. 그리고 부어 드리는 제물을 붓고, 화목제물의 피를 제단에 뿌렸다.

decisions.choice: burnt, grain, drink and peace offerings: the offerings that dedicate an altar
decisions.reason: These are the main kinds of offering in the law (Leviticus 1-3; Numbers 15:1-10). Offered together, they put the new altar into use, as Solomon's offerings did at the dedication of the temple (1 Kings 8:64).

decisions.choice: his ... which were his: the king's own offerings
decisions.reason: Each offering is called "his", and the peace offerings "which were his". These were the king's own offerings, not the people's.

decisions.choice: dashed: threw the blood against the altar
decisions.reason: The verb means to throw or splash a liquid. The blood of the offerings was thrown against the altar (Leviticus 3:2).

decisions.choice: dashed (Literal); splashed (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "splashed", as Leviticus 3:2 does; Literal keeps "dashed". Readable adds "on it" after the first clause so that every offering is placed on the new altar.

decisions.choice: "holocausto", "ofrenda de cereal", "libación" (L, B), "ofrenda de vino" (R), "sacrificios de paz"
decisions.reason: The names of the offerings as the Pentateuch terms note and the published Spanish Pentateuch set them; Readable says what the drink offering was.

decisions.choice: "roció"
decisions.reason: "Rociar" for the blood thrown against the altar at every level, as English Balanced and Readable say "splashed" (m3).

decisions.choice: "holocauste", "offrande végétale", "libation", "sacrifices de communion"
decisions.reason: The French names of the offerings set in the Pentateuch note and the Kings terms note, at every level.

decisions.choice: sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya kinywaji, sadaka za amani
decisions.reason: The names of the offerings as the published Swahili Leviticus and Numbers have them.

decisions.choice: của lễ thiêu; tế lễ chay; lễ quán; tế lễ bình an
decisions.reason: The offerings keep one name each: "tế lễ bình an" as the terms note sets for peace offerings, and the familiar "của lễ thiêu", "tế lễ chay" and "lễ quán" for the others.

decisions.choice: "번제물", "곡식 제물", "부어 드리는 제물", "화목제물"
decisions.reason: "번제" and "화목제" are the settled terms of the earlier notes; for the grain and drink offerings Korean uses descriptive words a reader understands rather than the Sino-Korean church terms.

source.text: וְאֵ֨ת הַמִּזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וַיַּקְרֵ֗ב מֵאֵת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת מִבֵּין֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמִבֵּ֖ין בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛וֹ עַל־יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ צָפֽוֹנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the altar the bronze which [was] before Yahweh, and he brought [it] near from with [the] front of the house, from between the altar and from between [the] house of Yahweh, and he put it on [the] side of the altar northward.

en.L: And the bronze altar that [was] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he brought [it] from the front of the house, from between the altar and the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he put it on the north side of the altar.
en.B: As for the bronze altar that stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he moved it from the front of the temple, from its place between the new altar and the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and set it beside the new altar on the north.
en.R: There was also the bronze altar that stood in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It stood between the new altar and the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Ahaz moved it away from the front of the temple and put it on the north side of the new altar.

es.L: Y el altar de bronce que [estaba] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, lo trasladó de delante de la casa, de entre el altar y la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y lo puso al lado del altar, hacia el norte.
es.B: En cuanto al altar de bronce que estaba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, lo quitó de la parte delantera del templo, de su lugar entre el altar nuevo y la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y lo puso al lado del altar nuevo, hacia el norte.
es.R: También estaba el altar de bronce que se encontraba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Estaba entre el altar nuevo y el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Acaz lo quitó de delante del templo y lo puso al lado norte del altar nuevo.

fr.L: Et l’autel de bronze qui [était] devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il le déplaça de devant la maison, d’entre l’autel et la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il le mit sur le côté de l’autel, vers le nord.
fr.B: Quant à l’autel de bronze qui se trouvait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il le retira de devant le temple, d’entre le nouvel autel et la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et le plaça à côté du nouvel autel, au nord.
fr.R: Il y avait aussi l’autel de bronze qui se trouvait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il était placé entre le nouvel autel et le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Achaz l’a enlevé de devant le temple et l’a mis au nord du nouvel autel.

sw.L: Na madhabahu ya shaba iliyokuwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaileta kutoka mbele ya nyumba, kutoka kati ya madhabahu na nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaiweka upande wa kaskazini wa madhabahu.
sw.B: Kuhusu madhabahu ya shaba iliyokuwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliiondoa mbele ya hekalu, mahali pake kati ya madhabahu mpya na nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaiweka kando ya madhabahu mpya upande wa kaskazini.
sw.R: Kulikuwa pia na madhabahu ya shaba iliyokuwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ilikuwa kati ya madhabahu mpya na hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ahazi akaiondoa mbele ya hekalu, akaiweka upande wa kaskazini wa madhabahu mpya.

vi.L: Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng ở trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua dời [nó] khỏi phía trước nhà, từ giữa bàn thờ và nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và đặt nó ở bên cạnh bàn thờ về phía bắc.
vi.B: Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng vẫn đặt trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua dời nó khỏi phía trước đền thờ, khỏi chỗ giữa bàn thờ mới và nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và đặt nó bên cạnh bàn thờ mới, về phía bắc.
vi.R: Cũng có bàn thờ bằng đồng đặt trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Bàn thờ ấy ở giữa bàn thờ mới và đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. A-cha dời nó khỏi phía trước đền thờ và đặt nó ở phía bắc của bàn thờ mới.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 [있던] 놋 제단을 그가 성전 앞에서, 곧 [새] 제단과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 사이에서 옮겨다가, 그것을 [새] 제단 북쪽 옆에 두었다.
ko.B: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 있던 놋 제단은, 성전 앞쪽 새 제단과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 사이에 있던 자리에서 옮겨, 새 제단 북쪽 옆에 두었다.
ko.R: 그곳에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 놓여 있던 놋 제단도 있었다. 그것은 새 제단과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 사이에 있었다. 아하스는 그 놋 제단을 성전 앞에서 옮겨 새 제단의 북쪽 옆에 두었다.

decisions.choice: the bronze altar that was before Yahweh: Solomon's altar
decisions.reason: This is the bronze altar Solomon made for the court in front of the temple, called by the same words at 1 Kings 8:64 (2 Chronicles 4:1). It stood before the temple entrance, where the offerings to Yahweh were made.

decisions.choice: brought it from between the altar and the house: moved it out of the way
decisions.reason: Ahaz's new altar seems to have been set up in front of the old one, east of it, so that the bronze altar stood between the new altar and the temple. Ahaz "brought it near", that is, moved it from that central place to the north side. The Hebrew puts the bronze altar first in the sentence, before the verb, to show that the verse now turns to it.

decisions.choice: before Yahweh ... the house of Yahweh: the altar of Yahweh pushed aside
decisions.reason: The divine name is repeated: the bronze altar stood before Yahweh, in front of his house. The new altar from Damascus now takes its place.

decisions.choice: the new altar
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "the altar". Balanced and Readable add "new" to tell the two altars apart. Readable puts the verse in three sentences and names Ahaz.

decisions.choice: "el altar nuevo"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "the altar"; Balanced and Readable add "nuevo" to tell the two altars apart, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[새] 제단" in brackets at Literal; "새 제단" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: With two altars in the verse, Korean needs to say which is meant; Literal marks the added word.

source.text: וַיְצַוֶּ֣ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־אָ֠חָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לֵאמֹ֗ר עַ֣ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ הַגָּד֡וֹל הַקְטֵ֣ר אֶת־עֹֽלַת־הַבֹּקֶר֩ וְאֶת־מִנְחַ֨ת הָעֶ֜רֶב וְֽאֶת־עֹלַ֧ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְאֶת־מִנְחָת֗וֹ וְ֠אֵת עֹלַ֞ת כָּל־עַ֤ם הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם וְכָל־דַּ֥ם עֹלָ֛ה וְכָל־דַּם־זֶ֖בַח עָלָ֣יו תִּזְרֹ֑ק וּמִזְבַּ֧ח הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֖י לְבַקֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And commanded the king Ahaz Uriah the priest, saying, on the altar the great make smoke [the] burnt offering of the morning and [the] grain offering of the evening and [the] burnt offering of the king and his grain offering and [the] burnt offering of all [the] people of the land and their grain offering and their drink offerings, and all [the] blood of burnt offering and all [the] blood of sacrifice on it you will dash; and [the] altar of the bronze will be for me to inquire.

en.L: And King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, saying, "On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, and the burnt offering of the king and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land and their grain offering and their drink offerings; and all the blood of [the] burnt offering and all the blood of [the] sacrifice you shall dash on it. And the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire [by]."
en.B: Then King Ahaz gave orders to Uriah the priest: "On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king's burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land with their grain offerings and drink offerings. Splash on it all the blood of the burnt offerings and of the sacrifices. But the bronze altar will be for me to seek guidance by."
en.R: Then King Ahaz gave Uriah the priest these orders: "Use the great new altar for all the offerings: the burnt offering in the morning and the grain offering in the evening, the king's burnt offering and grain offering, and the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings that all the people of the land bring. Splash all the blood of the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices on this altar. But I will use the bronze altar to seek guidance."

es.L: Y el rey Acaz mandó al sacerdote Urías, diciendo: «Sobre el altar grande quema el holocausto de la mañana y la ofrenda de cereal de la tarde, y el holocausto del rey y su ofrenda de cereal, y el holocausto de todo el pueblo de la tierra y su ofrenda de cereal y sus libaciones; y toda la sangre del holocausto y toda la sangre del sacrificio rociarás sobre él. Y el altar de bronce será para mí para consultar».
es.B: Entonces el rey Acaz le dio órdenes al sacerdote Urías: «Sobre el altar grande quema el holocausto de la mañana y la ofrenda de cereal de la tarde, el holocausto del rey y su ofrenda de cereal, y el holocausto de todo el pueblo de la tierra con sus ofrendas de cereal y sus libaciones. Rocía sobre él toda la sangre de los holocaustos y de los sacrificios. Pero el altar de bronce será para que yo busque dirección».
es.R: Entonces el rey Acaz le dio al sacerdote Urías estas órdenes: «Usa el altar grande y nuevo para todas las ofrendas: el holocausto de la mañana y la ofrenda de cereal de la tarde, el holocausto y la ofrenda de cereal del rey, y los holocaustos, las ofrendas de cereal y las ofrendas de vino que traiga todo el pueblo del país. Rocía sobre este altar toda la sangre de los holocaustos y de los demás sacrificios. Pero yo usaré el altar de bronce para buscar dirección».

fr.L: Et le roi Achaz donna cet ordre au prêtre Urie : « Sur le grand autel, fais brûler l’holocauste du matin et l’offrande végétale du soir, et l’holocauste du roi et son offrande végétale, et l’holocauste de tout le peuple du pays et leur offrande végétale et leurs libations ; et tout le sang d’holocauste et tout le sang de sacrifice, tu les aspergeras sur lui. Et l’autel de bronze sera pour moi, pour consulter. »
fr.B: Puis le roi Achaz donna ses ordres au prêtre Urie : « Sur le grand autel, tu feras brûler l’holocauste du matin et l’offrande végétale du soir, l’holocauste du roi et son offrande végétale, ainsi que l’holocauste de tout le peuple du pays avec ses offrandes végétales et ses libations. Tu y aspergeras tout le sang des holocaustes et des sacrifices. Quant à l’autel de bronze, il me servira pour consulter. »
fr.R: Ensuite le roi Achaz a donné ces ordres au prêtre Urie : « Utilise le grand autel neuf pour toutes les offrandes : l’holocauste du matin et l’offrande végétale du soir, l’holocauste et l’offrande végétale du roi, et les holocaustes, les offrandes végétales et les libations que tout le peuple du pays apporte. Asperge cet autel avec tout le sang des holocaustes et des autres sacrifices. Mais moi, j’utiliserai l’autel de bronze pour demander des conseils. »

sw.L: Naye mfalme Ahazi akamwamuru Uria kuhani, akisema, "Juu ya madhabahu kubwa teketeza sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi na sadaka ya nafaka ya jioni, na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mfalme na sadaka yake ya nafaka, na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya watu wote wa nchi na sadaka yao ya nafaka na sadaka zao za kinywaji; na damu yote ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na damu yote ya dhabihu utainyunyiza juu yake. Na madhabahu ya shaba itakuwa kwangu kwa kuulizia."
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Ahazi akampa Uria kuhani maagizo: "Juu ya madhabahu kubwa teketeza sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi na sadaka ya nafaka ya jioni, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mfalme na sadaka yake ya nafaka, na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya watu wote wa nchi pamoja na sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka zao za kinywaji. Irushie damu yote ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na ya dhabihu. Lakini madhabahu ya shaba itakuwa yangu ya kutafutia maongozi."
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Ahazi akampa Uria kuhani maagizo haya: "Tumia madhabahu kubwa mpya kwa sadaka zote: sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi na sadaka ya nafaka ya jioni, sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka ya mfalme, na sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji wanazoleta watu wote wa nchi. Rushia madhabahu hii damu yote ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na ya dhabihu nyingine. Lakini mimi nitaitumia madhabahu ya shaba kutafuta maongozi."

vi.L: Vua A-cha truyền lệnh cho thầy tế lễ U-ri rằng: "Trên bàn thờ lớn, hãy thiêu của lễ thiêu buổi sáng và tế lễ chay buổi chiều, của lễ thiêu của vua và tế lễ chay của vua, của lễ thiêu của toàn dân trong xứ, tế lễ chay và các lễ quán của họ; mọi huyết của [các] của lễ thiêu và mọi huyết của [các] sinh tế, ngươi hãy rảy trên đó. Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng sẽ để cho ta cầu hỏi."
vi.B: Rồi vua A-cha truyền lệnh cho thầy tế lễ U-ri: "Trên bàn thờ lớn, hãy thiêu của lễ thiêu buổi sáng và tế lễ chay buổi chiều, của lễ thiêu và tế lễ chay của vua, cùng của lễ thiêu của toàn dân trong xứ với tế lễ chay và lễ quán của họ. Hãy vẩy trên bàn thờ ấy mọi huyết của các của lễ thiêu và các sinh tế. Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng thì ta sẽ dùng để cầu hỏi."
vi.R: Rồi vua A-cha ra lệnh cho thầy tế lễ U-ri: "Hãy dùng bàn thờ lớn mới này cho mọi lễ vật: của lễ thiêu buổi sáng và tế lễ chay buổi chiều, của lễ thiêu và tế lễ chay của vua, và các của lễ thiêu, tế lễ chay và lễ quán mà toàn dân trong xứ mang đến. Hãy vẩy mọi huyết của các của lễ thiêu và các sinh tế khác trên bàn thờ này. Còn bàn thờ bằng đồng thì ta sẽ dùng để cầu hỏi ý Chúa."

ko.L: 그리고 아하스 왕이 제사장 우리야에게 명령하여 말했다. "큰 제단 위에서 아침 번제물과 저녁 곡식 제물과, 왕의 번제물과 그의 곡식 제물과, 이 땅의 모든 백성의 번제물과 그들의 곡식 제물과 그들의 부어 드리는 제물들을 불사르고, 번제물의 모든 피와 [다른] 제물의 모든 피를 그 위에 뿌려라. 그리고 놋 제단은 내가 [뜻을] 여쭈는 데 쓰겠다."
ko.B: 그리고 아하스 왕은 제사장 우리야에게 명령했다. "큰 제단 위에서 아침 번제물과 저녁 곡식 제물, 왕의 번제물과 곡식 제물, 이 땅 모든 백성의 번제물과 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물을 불살라라. 번제물과 다른 제물의 피도 모두 그 위에 뿌려라. 그러나 놋 제단은 내가 뜻을 묻는 데 쓰겠다."
ko.R: 그리고 아하스 왕은 제사장 우리야에게 이렇게 명령했다. "모든 제물을 새로 만든 큰 제단에서 바쳐라. 아침 번제물과 저녁 곡식 제물, 왕의 번제물과 곡식 제물, 그리고 이 땅의 모든 백성이 가져오는 번제물과 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물을 다 거기에서 바쳐라. 번제물과 다른 제물의 피도 모두 이 제단에 뿌려라. 그러나 놋 제단은 내가 뜻을 물어볼 때 쓰겠다."

decisions.choice: commanded: the reading of the Hebrew tradition
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has "commanded him", with a pronoun that points ahead to Uriah; the tradition of reading it aloud reads "commanded" alone. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering: the daily offerings
decisions.reason: The law set a burnt offering every morning and evening, each with grain and drink offerings (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8). Kings names "the offering" at the evening hour (1 Kings 18:29, 36). All the regular worship is now to be done at the new altar.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: "The people of the land" are the free landowning people of Judah, who had a voice in national affairs (11:14, 18-20). Their offerings, like the king's, are moved to the new altar.

decisions.choice: the bronze altar shall be for me to inquire by: for the king to seek guidance
alternatives: the bronze altar will be for me to consider (what to do with it)
decisions.reason: The verb means to look into or examine something closely (Leviticus 13:36; 27:33), and to seek God in his temple (Psalm 27:4). Ahaz may mean that he will use the old altar to seek a word from God, perhaps by examining the parts of sacrifices for signs, as the peoples around Israel did. Or he may mean only that he will consider later what to do with it. The words are brief, and the sense is not certain.

decisions.choice: the great altar: the new altar from Damascus
decisions.reason: "The great altar" is the new one, larger than Solomon's bronze altar, which had already proved too small for great occasions (1 Kings 8:64).

decisions.choice: Use the great new altar for all the offerings: ...
decisions.reason: Readable starts with what Ahaz wants and then lists the offerings, and it adds "new" (verse 14). It puts the people's offerings together in one phrase.

decisions.choice: splash; seek guidance
decisions.reason: "Splash" as in verse 13. "Seek guidance" says what "inquire" means in the reading followed here (m4). Balanced and Readable say "But" because the bronze altar is set against the great altar.

decisions.choice: "buscar dirección"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "inquire" means in the reading followed here (m4); Literal keeps "consultar".

decisions.choice: "pour consulter" (L, B); "pour demander des conseils" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is used for seeking guidance (m4); the French keeps it general, as the English does, without saying how the king sought it.

decisions.choice: irushie damu; kutafuta maongozi
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "throw" the blood against the altar (meaning decision m3 of verse 13) and "seek guidance" for the inquiry, as the English does; Literal keeps "kuulizia".

decisions.choice: the king to the priest: ta / ngươi (L); ta with plain commands (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ahaz speaks to his priest as a king to a subject, "ta"; Literal keeps "ngươi", Balanced and Readable give plain commands without a pronoun for Uriah.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to the priest in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: The king to a subject, as the Samuel note sets; here the priest simply obeys (verse 16).

en.B: Uriah the priest did everything King Ahaz commanded.
en.R: Uriah the priest did everything King Ahaz told him to do.

es.B: El sacerdote Urías hizo todo lo que el rey Acaz le mandó.
es.R: El sacerdote Urías hizo todo lo que el rey Acaz le dijo.

fr.B: Le prêtre Urie fit tout ce que le roi Achaz avait ordonné.
fr.R: Le prêtre Urie a fait tout ce que le roi Achaz lui avait demandé.

sw.B: Uria kuhani alifanya kila kitu mfalme Ahazi alichoamuru.
sw.R: Uria kuhani alifanya kila kitu ambacho mfalme Ahazi alimwambia afanye.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ U-ri làm theo mọi điều vua A-cha truyền.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ U-ri làm đúng mọi điều vua A-cha truyền.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ U-ri làm mọi điều vua A-cha bảo.

ko.B: 제사장 우리야는 아하스 왕이 명령한 대로 모두 했다.
ko.R: 제사장 우리야는 아하스 왕이 시킨 대로 다 했다.

decisions.choice: did according to all that the king commanded: the priest obeys the king
decisions.reason: The words echo the way Moses and Israel did "according to all that Yahweh commanded" (Exodus 39:42). The priest of Yahweh's temple now carries out the king's commands without question, unlike the priest Jehoiada, who led the overthrow of Athaliah (chapter 11).

source.text: וַיְקַצֵּץ֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּר֣וֹת הַמְּכֹנ֗וֹת וַיָּ֤סַר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֔ר וְאֶת־הַיָּ֣ם הוֹרִ֔ד מֵעַ֛ל הַבָּקָ֥ר הַנְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל מַרְצֶ֥פֶת אֲבָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And cut off the king Ahaz the panels of the stands, and he removed from on them the basin; and the sea he took down from on the oxen the bronze which [were] under it, and he put it on a pavement of stones.

en.L: And King Ahaz cut off the panels of the stands and removed the basin from on them; and he took down the sea from on the bronze oxen that [were] under it, and he put it on a pavement of stones.
en.B: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the stands and removed the basins from them. He took the Sea down from the bronze oxen that held it up and set it on a stone pavement.
en.R: King Ahaz cut off the side panels of the stands and took the basins off them. He also took the huge bronze tank called the Sea down from the bronze oxen that held it up, and he set it on a base made of stones.

es.L: Y el rey Acaz cortó los tableros de las basas y quitó de encima de ellas la pila; y bajó el mar de sobre los bueyes de bronce que [estaban] debajo de él, y lo puso sobre un pavimento de piedras.
es.B: El rey Acaz cortó los tableros de las basas y les quitó las pilas. Bajó el Mar de encima de los bueyes de bronce que lo sostenían y lo puso sobre un pavimento de piedra.
es.R: El rey Acaz cortó los tableros laterales de las basas y les quitó las pilas. También bajó el enorme depósito de bronce llamado el Mar de encima de los bueyes de bronce que lo sostenían, y lo puso sobre una base hecha de piedras.

fr.L: Et le roi Achaz découpa les panneaux des bases et en ôta le bassin ; et la Mer, il la fit descendre de dessus les bœufs de bronze qui [étaient] sous elle, et il la mit sur un pavement de pierres.
fr.B: Le roi Achaz découpa les panneaux des bases et en retira les bassins. Il fit descendre la Mer de dessus les bœufs de bronze qui la portaient et la posa sur un dallage de pierre.
fr.R: Le roi Achaz a découpé les panneaux sur les côtés des bases, et il en a enlevé les bassins. Il a aussi descendu l’énorme cuve de bronze appelée la Mer de dessus les bœufs de bronze qui la portaient, et il l’a posée sur un socle de pierres.

sw.L: Naye mfalme Ahazi akakata mbao za pembeni za vitako, akaliondoa birika kutoka juu yake; na ile bahari akaishusha kutoka juu ya ng'ombe wa shaba waliokuwa chini yake, akaiweka juu ya sakafu ya mawe.
sw.B: Mfalme Ahazi alikata mbao za pembeni za vitako, akayaondoa mabirika kutoka juu yake. Akaishusha Bahari kutoka juu ya ng'ombe wa shaba walioibeba, akaiweka juu ya sakafu ya mawe.
sw.R: Mfalme Ahazi alikata mbao za pembeni za vitako, akayaondoa mabirika yaliyokuwa juu yake. Pia akaishusha ile tangi kubwa la shaba lililoitwa Bahari kutoka juu ya ng'ombe wa shaba waliolibeba, akaliweka juu ya kitako cha mawe.

vi.L: Vua A-cha cắt các tấm ván của các chân đế, và dời cái bồn khỏi trên chúng; còn cái biển, vua hạ xuống khỏi các con bò bằng đồng ở dưới nó, và đặt nó trên nền lát đá.
vi.B: Vua A-cha cắt bỏ các tấm ván của các chân đế và dời các bồn khỏi chân đế. Vua hạ cái Biển khỏi các con bò bằng đồng đỡ nó và đặt nó trên một nền lát đá.
vi.R: Vua A-cha cắt bỏ các tấm ván bên hông các chân đế và lấy các bồn ra khỏi chân đế. Vua cũng hạ cái bể lớn bằng đồng gọi là cái Biển xuống khỏi các con bò bằng đồng đỡ nó, và đặt nó trên một nền bằng đá.

ko.L: 그리고 아하스 왕이 받침대들의 판들을 잘라 내고 그것들 위에서 물두멍을 떼어 냈다. 그리고 그 바다를 그 아래에 있는 놋 소들 위에서 내려 돌을 깐 바닥 위에 두었다.
ko.B: 아하스 왕은 받침대들의 옆판을 잘라 내고 그 위에 있던 물두멍들을 떼어 냈다. 그는 또 바다를 떠받치고 있던 놋 소들 위에서 그것을 내려 돌로 된 바닥 위에 놓았다.
ko.R: 아하스 왕은 받침대들의 옆판을 잘라 내고 그 위에 있던 물두멍들을 떼어 냈다. 또 '바다'라고 부르던 커다란 놋 물통을 그것을 떠받치던 놋 소들 위에서 내려, 돌로 만든 받침 위에 놓았다.

decisions.choice: the stands, the basins and the Sea: Solomon's bronze furnishings
decisions.reason: These were made for Solomon's temple: ten bronze stands on wheels, each with panels on its sides and a basin on top, and the great bronze basin called the Sea, which rested on twelve bronze oxen (1 Kings 7:23-39). The Sea is not a body of water but a great tank.

decisions.choice: why Ahaz stripped them: probably for their bronze
alternatives: to change the temple to suit the new altar
decisions.reason: The text gives no reason here. Verse 18 ends "because of the king of Assyria", and the bronze may have been needed for tribute to Assyria. The oxen were later carried off by the Babylonians (Jeremiah 52:20).

decisions.choice: the basin: each basin, all ten
decisions.reason: "The basin" is singular, but it refers to the basin on each of the stands (1 Kings 7:38).

decisions.choice: basins
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "basins", since there was one on each stand (m3). Readable explains the Sea as a huge bronze tank, as at 1 Kings 7:23, and says "side panels" as at 1 Kings 7:28.

decisions.choice: "las basas", "la pila" (L), "las pilas" (B, R), "el Mar"
decisions.reason: The names of Solomon's bronze furnishings; "el Mar" as the terms note's "el Mar de bronce". Balanced and Readable say "pilas", one on each stand (m3), and Readable explains the Sea, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "bases", "bassins", "la Mer"
decisions.reason: The terms of Solomon's bronze furnishings (1 Kings 7) as the terms note sets them; Readable explains "la Mer" as a huge bronze tank, as the English does.

decisions.choice: vitako; Bahari (Readable: tangi kubwa la shaba lililoitwa Bahari)
decisions.reason: The bronze Sea in the terms note's wording; Readable says what it was, as the English does. "Mbao za pembeni" are the side panels, "vitako" the stands.

decisions.choice: các bồn (B, R); cái Biển; cái bể lớn bằng đồng gọi là cái Biển (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "các bồn", one on each stand (m3). The bronze Sea keeps its name, "cái Biển", from the terms note; Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "물두멍" for the basins; "바다" (L, B), "'바다'라고 부르던 커다란 놋 물통" (R)
decisions.reason: "물두멍" is the established word for the temple basins; the terms note names Solomon's Sea "놋 바다", and here the verse itself mentions the bronze, so Literal and Balanced say "바다" and Readable explains it.
