records.literal_gloss: And [the] covered [structure] of the Sabbath which they had built in the house, and [the] entrance of the king the outer, he turned [from the] house of Yahweh because of [the] king of Assyria.

en.L: And the covered [structure] of the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the outer entrance of the king, he turned [away from] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because of the king of Assyria.
en.B: He also removed from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the covered place for the Sabbath that had been built at the temple, and the king's outer entrance. He did this because of the king of Assyria.
en.R: He also took away from the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the covered place used on the Sabbath that had been built there, and the king's outside entrance. He did this because of the king of Assyria.

es.L: Y el [pórtico] cubierto del sábado que habían edificado en la casa, y la entrada exterior del rey, los quitó [de] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a causa del rey de Asiria.
es.B: También quitó de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el lugar cubierto para el sábado que se había construido en el templo, y la entrada exterior del rey. Lo hizo a causa del rey de Asiria.
es.R: También quitó del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el lugar cubierto que se usaba en el sábado y que se había construido allí, y la entrada exterior del rey. Lo hizo a causa del rey de Asiria.

fr.L: Et le [portique] couvert du sabbat qu’on avait bâti dans la maison, et l’entrée extérieure du roi, il [les] détourna de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à cause du roi d’Assyrie.
fr.B: Il retira aussi de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le portique couvert pour le sabbat qu’on avait construit dans le temple, ainsi que l’entrée extérieure du roi. Il le fit à cause du roi d’Assyrie.
fr.R: Il a aussi enlevé du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} l’abri couvert utilisé pour le sabbat qu’on y avait construit, et l’entrée extérieure réservée au roi. Il a fait cela à cause du roi d’Assyrie.

sw.L: Na kibanda cha Sabato walichokuwa wamekijenga ndani ya nyumba, na mlango wa nje wa mfalme, akavigeuza [kutoka katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.B: Pia aliondoa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali penye paa palipotumika siku ya Sabato palipokuwa pamejengwa hekaluni, na mlango wa nje wa mfalme. Alifanya hivyo kwa sababu ya mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.R: Pia aliondoa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali penye paa palipotumika siku ya Sabato palipojengwa huko, na mlango wa nje wa mfalme. Alifanya hivyo kwa sababu ya mfalme wa Ashuru.

vi.L: Mái che ngày Sa-bát mà người ta đã xây trong nhà, và lối vào bên ngoài của vua, vua dời [khỏi] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì cớ vua A-si-ri.
vi.B: Vua cũng dời khỏi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chỗ có mái che dùng vào ngày Sa-bát đã được xây trong đền thờ, và lối vào bên ngoài của vua. Vua làm vậy vì cớ vua A-si-ri.
vi.R: Vua cũng dời khỏi đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chỗ có mái che dùng vào ngày Sa-bát đã được xây ở đó, và lối vào bên ngoài dành cho vua. Vua làm vậy vì cớ vua A-si-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 성전에 지어 놓았던 안식일의 덮개 [구조물]과 왕의 바깥 입구를, 그가 앗시리아 왕 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 돌려 놓았다.
ko.B: 그는 또 성전에 지어 놓았던 안식일에 쓰는 덮인 곳과 왕이 드나드는 바깥 입구를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 없앴다. 앗시리아 왕 때문에 그렇게 한 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 또 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 지어 놓았던, 안식일에 쓰는 지붕 덮인 곳과 왕이 드나드는 바깥 입구를 치워 버렸다. 앗시리아 왕의 비위를 맞추려고 그렇게 한 것이다.

decisions.choice: the covered structure of the Sabbath: something covered, used on the Sabbath
alternatives: the covered walkway for the Sabbath
the base of the (royal) seat (Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning "to cover" and is found only here. It may have been a covered walkway, or a covered platform or stand where the king sat or stood at the Sabbath gatherings (compare 11:14). The written Hebrew spells the word differently from the way the tradition reads it aloud, and the ancient Greek translation seems to have read "the base of the seat". What it was exactly is not known; reviewers should check the evidence.

decisions.choice: the outer entrance of the king: the king's own way into the temple
decisions.reason: This was a private entrance from the palace into the temple area, used by the king, as the palace stood beside the temple.

decisions.choice: he turned from the house of Yahweh: removed, or changed
alternatives: he changed them in the house of Yahweh
he moved them around the house of Yahweh
decisions.reason: The verb means "to turn" or "to cause to go around". With the house of Yahweh it most likely means that Ahaz removed these things from the temple. It may instead mean that he altered them or turned them around within the temple area.

decisions.choice: because of the king of Assyria: to satisfy his overlord
decisions.reason: The text does not say exactly why. Ahaz may have removed signs of royal power and independence that would offend his overlord, or taken materials to pay tribute (verse 17). Either way, the changes to Yahweh's house were made out of regard for the king of Assyria.

decisions.choice: He also removed ... He did this because of the king of Assyria.
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the objects first. Balanced and Readable put the verb first and give the reason in a sentence of its own. They say "the covered place", keeping the wording general because the object is not known (m1).

decisions.choice: "el [pórtico] cubierto del sábado" (L); "el lugar cubierto para el sábado" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sense of the rare word is uncertain (m1); Literal brackets "pórtico" as the English brackets "structure", and Balanced and Readable say only "lugar cubierto".

decisions.choice: "le [portique] couvert du sabbat" (L, B); "l'abri couvert" (R)
decisions.reason: No one knows what the covered structure was (m1); "portique" and "abri" keep it as a covered place without guessing more than the English does.

decisions.choice: kibanda cha Sabato
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names "a covered thing of the Sabbath" whose form is not known (meaning decision m1); Literal says "kibanda", a covered structure, and Balanced and Readable describe it.

source.text: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָחָ֖ז אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Ahaz which he did, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Judah?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Ahaz that he did, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Ahaz, what he did, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
en.R: Everything else Ahaz did is written in the history of the kings of Judah.

es.L: Y los demás hechos que hizo Acaz, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Acaz, lo que hizo, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Acaz está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Achaz, ce qu’il fit, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Achaz, ce qu’il fit, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Achaz a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Ahazi aliyoyafanya, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Yuda?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Ahazi, aliyoyafanya, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Ahazi yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-cha mà ông đã làm, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Giu-đa sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-cha, những điều ông đã làm, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-cha đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 아하스가 한 나머지 일들은 유다 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 아하스의 나머지 행적, 곧 그가 한 일은 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아하스가 한 나머지 일은 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah: a royal record the writer used
decisions.reason: As at 8:23, the writer sends the reader to a fuller record of the reigns of Judah's kings, now lost. The question "are they not written ...?" means "they are written".

decisions.choice: more about Ahaz in Chronicles and Isaiah
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 28 tells of further defeats in Ahaz's reign and of his closing the doors of the temple (28:24). Isaiah 7 tells of his meeting with the prophet during the attack of verse 5.

decisions.choice: a statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the question; Balanced and Readable state the fact, as throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Judá" (R)
alternatives: el libro de las Crónicas de los reyes de Judá
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it, and avoids "Crónicas", the Spanish title of the book of Chronicles.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָחָז֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם־אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Ahaz with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers in [the] city of David, and reigned Hezekiah his son in his place.

en.L: And Ahaz lay down with his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Ahaz rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His son Hezekiah became king in his place.
en.R: Then Ahaz died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. His son Hezekiah became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Acaz con sus padres, y fue sepultado con sus padres en la ciudad de David; y reinó en su lugar Ezequías su hijo.
es.B: Acaz descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado con ellos en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Ezequías reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Acaz murió y fue sepultado con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Ezequías lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Achaz se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la cité de David ; et Ézéchias son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Achaz reposa avec ses ancêtres et fut enterré avec eux dans la cité de David. Son fils Ézéchias régna à sa place.
fr.R: Puis Achaz est mort et il a été enterré avec ses ancêtres dans la cité de David. Son fils Ézéchias est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Ahazi akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa pamoja na baba zake katika mji wa Daudi; na Hezekia mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Ahazi alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa pamoja nao katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Hezekia akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Ahazi alikufa, akazikwa pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Hezekia akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: A-cha nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình và được chôn với tổ phụ mình trong thành Đa-vít; Ê-xê-chia con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Rồi A-cha an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít. Ê-xê-chia con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi A-cha qua đời và được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít. Ê-xê-chia con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 아하스가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 다윗 성에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그리고 그의 아들 히스기야가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 아하스는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 히스기야가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아하스는 죽었고, 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 히스기야가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of Kings (1 Kings 15:8, 24). Here the Hebrew also names his burial "with his fathers" in the City of David.

decisions.choice: buried in the City of David: 2 Chronicles adds a difference
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 28:27 says that Ahaz was buried in the city, in Jerusalem, but was not brought into the tombs of the kings of Israel. Kings says only that he was buried with his fathers in the City of David.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah his son
decisions.reason: Hezekiah's reign is told in chapters 18-20, where he is praised as a king who trusted Yahweh as none before or after him (18:5).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died ... and was buried with his ancestors
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings; Readable keeps the burial with his ancestors because the Hebrew names it.

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); "Ezequías"
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas keep one wording at each level, as the terms note sets them; "Ezequías" as its table gives Hezekiah.
